messages.subject: Garrety - advice note (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Please find attached our advice note on the Garrety matter. In short: the Company has decent arguments on causation, but the whistleblowing and age-discrimination claims carry uncapped exposure, so we recommend an agreed exit now. I suggest a package in the region of £230k-£240k gross and recommend the board authorise settlement up to a ceiling of around £245k.

Proposed sequence: grievance outcome 24 Feb (partly upholding consultation failings), then a without-prejudice s.111A offer on 26 Feb with a 14-day window. Happy to discuss.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
